title: Darts: the greats overview
d: The greatest Darts players, ranked by titles, records, and influence.
definition: The greatest Darts players, ranked by titles, records, and influence.
description: The pantheon of Darts is argued in every bar and barbershop, but the names in this database appear on every serious list: champions who won the biggest prizes, record-setters whose numbers still stand, and pioneers who changed how Darts is played. Greatness here is measured three ways — winning, statistics, and influence — and the truest greats score on all three. Study them not to worship but to learn: every great was once a beginner who mastered fundamentals.

title: Phil Taylor
d: Phil Taylor (1988-2018): 16 world titles; the Power.
definition: Phil Taylor (1988-2018): 16 world titles; the Power.
description: Phil Taylor competed at the top of Darts from 1988-2018, and the achievement that defines the career is this: 16 world titles; the Power. What separated Phil Taylor was not one skill but the complete package — technique hardened by repetition, tactics sharpened by study, and the temperament to deliver when everything is on the line. Young players should study not just the highlights but the habits: the training volume, the professionalism, and the longevity that turned talent into legacy.

title: Phil Taylor: legacy
